caption: This drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a pair of metal sugar tongs, centered on a rectangular piece of paper. The tongs are drawn in a horizontal orientation, with the gripping ends (spoon-like shapes) facing the right and slightly separated. The handles are joined on the left, forming an oval-shaped opening, and the arms gently curve outwards before tapering to the gripping ends. The drawing uses shades of gray and black for outlines and shading, with subtle hints of pink and yellow tones added for metallic highlights and reflections. The tongs feature a simple, linear design on the visible side. The background is a plain, light-colored paper that shows some age discoloration, with the outer margins of the paper left mostly empty and unadorned.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
